Configuration.Name: Request Form Popup
Configuration.Author: Atlas Systems, Inc.
Configuration.Description: Displays a popup box with a configurable message when a request is opened that contains a value in the specified field. This field must be either a default field in the Transactions database table or a Transaction-type custom field.

Setting.name: PopupField
Setting.Description: The field that will trigger the popup to display if it contains a value. Must be a default field in the Transactions table or a Transaction-type custom field. If a custom field is selected, enter the short name for the field as defined in the Customization Manager's CustomFieldDefinitions table.

Setting.name: CustomField
Setting.Description: Must be checked if the PopupField is a custom field.

Setting.name: Message
Setting.Description: Sets the message that displays in the popup.
